thread:
alex: Observing a spike of TLS handshake errors for cross-region traffic (eu-west -> ap-south) right after the infra RBAC push this morning. Logs show session-ticket unwrap failures and a change in the negotiated cipher on some proxies. Anyone touch keystore perms?

riley: Which RBAC change are you seeing? I merged a few keystore PRs earlier but thought they were scoped. Can you paste the failure snippet?

alex: Heres a quick probe from one affected proxy: 
```
$ openssl s_client -connect svc-ingest.eu-west.internal:443 -servername ingest
---
Protocol  : TLSv1.3
Cipher    : TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
Session-ID: <empty>
Session-Ticket: present (len=0)
verify return:1
---
```
Daemon logs: `ptls: unwrap failed - kms_decrypt: AccessDenied` followed by `session-ticket: low-entropy fallback` repeatedly.

tara: I reviewed infra change set PR #4922 earlier - it replaced broad `keystore-reader` with `keystore-fetch-only` for the proxy service account, to limit list/inspect perms. Did that PR include KMS Decrypt scope?

riley: No, the intention was to narrow list and read roles; I remember explicitly excluding Decrypt to avoid over-permissioning. Guess we broke unwrap then.

audit-bot: [alert] 2025-02-03T09:12:41Z - tls-handshake-failures-euwest-ap-south - 58 handshakes failed in 12m. Incident draft: INC-2025-072.

sre-oncall: Immediate triage: 1) confirm service account cannot call kms:Decrypt via iam-simulate 2) check keystore rotator logs for unwrap denies 3) temporarily broaden role to include decrypt for affected proxies if confirmed 4) track audit log lines for Decrypt attempts.

alex: iam simulate shows: `iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy: Denied: kms:Decrypt` from the proxy SA when targeting the regional keystore resource. That's consistent.

tara: Ok that's root cause then. Without decrypt the proxy falls back to session-ticket cache logic which in our code treats empty tickets as low-entropy attempts and logs high severity.

riley: Short-term plan: I'll patch IAM to add `kms:Decrypt` only scoped to the proxy-keystore resource and roll to the eu-west proxies. Will also enable 24h detailed audit logging for KMS decrypts for the affected regional keys. ETA ~12m.

sre-oncall: Please coordinate the rollback against the deployment pipeline. Also add a health-check that exercises KMS unwrap as part of the proxy post-deploy smoke tests.

audit-bot: [action] Attached: PR #4922 (rbac diffs), CloudTrail entries for kms:Decrypt denies (2025-02-03T09:08-09:20Z).

tara: For long-term: rotator team needs a design doc for least-privilege unwrap flow - two options: a) grant scoped kms:Decrypt to proxy SA + strict resource ARNs b) keep decrypt in a rotator service that proxies unwraps with audited calls. We'll need tests either way.

riley: Agreed. Also we should reduce log severity for fallback low-entropy path so alerts don't spam SRE when unwraps are transient. But first fix the perms.

alex: After IAM patch and rolling proxies, my validation probe returns: 
```
$ openssl s_client -connect svc-ingest.eu-west.internal:443 -servername ingest
---
Protocol  : TLSv1.3
Cipher    : TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
Session-ID: <empty>
Session-Ticket: present (len=256)
verify return:1
---
```
No unwrap errors and handshake failures drop to baseline.

sre-oncall: Mitigation applied: temporary scoped `kms:Decrypt` grant to proxy SA. Created two follow-ups: ENGSEC-1283 (rotator least-privilege design) and ENGOPS-2214 (deploy-time KMS unwrap + openssl handshake check per region).

audit-bot: [update] INC-2025-072 created and marked mitigated at 2025-02-03T09:34:10Z after IAM patch. Linked logs and PRs.

tara: Compliance ask: capture PR timeline, exact IAM delta, and evidence that rollback resolved the handshake anomalies (probes + cloudtrail). I'll compile for the review board.

riley: Will paste the IAM diff and the CloudTrail `Decrypt` success entries into the incident ticket in the next 10m. Also setting a 24h retention window for decrypt logs for post-incident analysis.

alex: Lessons learned: 1) tighten RBAC only after verifying unwrap path 2) session-ticket unwrap failures surface as entropy/fallback logs, not direct TLS 403s 3) add gating tests in CI for RBAC changes touching keystore/rotator resources.

sre-oncall: I'll update the runbook: "Keystore RBAC changes: run iam-simulate + live unwrap test + region handshake smoke test; if unwrap denies, rollback scoped perms immediately; enable audit log window."

tara: Thanks team. Once incident doc is complete I'll schedule a short design review with rotator and infra to settle the long-term unwrap ownership model.

riley: Rolling the scoped change now. Will update INC-2025-072 with timestamps and audit entries. :white_check_mark:
